units.rawText: "Once there were trees full of birds, meadowlands vibrant with flowers; carefree the songs our children once sang... gilding our minutes and hours..."
units.displayText: "Once there were trees full of birds, meadowlands vibrant with flowers; carefree the songs our children once sang... gilding our minutes and hours..."

spans.text: "Once there were trees full of birds, meadowlands vibrant with flowers; carefree the songs our children once sang... gilding our minutes and hours..."

units.rawText: I must have learned these lyrics from that old lady. It's just... All I remember is this snippet of lyrics. I can't even recall the melody.

units.rawText: If I ever see her and the blue-haired lady ever again, I can probably finish the whole song...

units.rawText: Then I'll teach it to you and the others! That way, it will never, ever be forgotten!
